question: Rann Utsav is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rann Utsav** is a cultural festival that takes place in the **Rann of Kutch**, a vast **salt desert** in **Gujarat.**
 
• It usually happens between **November and February** and lasts for several days.
 
• The festival showcases the rich heritage and traditions of **Gujarat**, with a focus on **local art, music, dance, and cuisine.**
 
• Visitors can enjoy various activities such as **camel rides, folk performances, handicrafts shopping, and stargazing**.
 
• Rann Utsav is organized by the **Gujarat Tourism Department** and attracts a large number of domestic and international tourists every year.
 
• It is considered one of the biggest cultural events in India and helps promote** tourism and the local economy.**
 
• Some of the popular attractions during Rann Utsav include the **Tent City,** a temporary settlement of luxury tents and cottages, the **White Desert**, a mesmerizing landscape of salt crystals and mirages, and the** Kala Dungar,** the highest point in Kutch offering panoramic views of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Goa** is a state in southwest India known for its **beaches, nightlife, and Portuguese colonial architecture.**

 
 
• It hosts several festivals throughout the year, such as the** Goa Carnival, the International Film Festival of India, and the Sunburn Music Festival.**
 
 
 
• **Punjab **is a state in northern India known for its **agriculture, cuisine, and religious diversity**.
 
 
• It celebrates several festivals related to **Sikhism**, such as the** Guru Nanak Jayanti, the Baisakhi, and the Holla Mohalla.**
 
 
 
• **Haryana **is a state in northern India known for its historical and cultural significance.
 
 
• It hosts several fairs and festivals, such as the **Surajkund Crafts Mela, the Pinjore Heritage Festival, and the Gita Jayanti.**
